question: Into how many proportional parts may the pericarp be divided?
premises: The pericarp is measured in parts.
The allowed divisions range from one to six parts.
The prescription is given as an option.
inference: The pericarp may be made in one, two, three, four, five, or six parts.
plain_english: The pericarp should be made in one, two, three, four, five, or six parts.
